title: Direct offer-contrast concentration improves the retraining decision certificate
checked_scope: The bounded finite-stratum randomized offer experiment, sharpening treatment-effect error radii and optimizing fixed within-stratum sampling allocation.
significance: A direct weighted Hoeffding bound replaces triangle radii and yields an exact continuous minimax design allocating sqrt(P) times as many controls as workers per active offer.
